\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Normal Jacobi fields in semigeodetic coordinates] 1. ch10:10-15↗ prop:characterizations-semigeodetic-coordinates

Let $(x^1,\ldots ,x^n)$ be any semigeodetic coordinates on an open subset $U$ in a Riemannian $n$-manifold $(M,g)$ (see Prop. 6.41 and Examples 6.43--6.46), and let $\gamma (t) = (x^1,\ldots ,x^{n-1},t)$ be an $x^n$-coordinate curve defined on some interval $I$. Prove that for all constants $(a^1,\ldots ,a^{n-1})$, the following vector field along $\gamma $ is a normal Jacobi field along $\gamma $ that is transverse to each of the level sets of $x^n$ (in the sense defined in Problem 10-14): \[ J(t) = \sum _{i=1}^{n-1} a^i \frac{\partial }{\partial x^i}\bigg|_{\gamma (t)}. \] \end{exercise}
